pv35:1.1: Antalikkhasmiṃ tiṭṭhanto duggandho pūti vāyasi mukhañ ca te kimayo pūtigandhaṃ khādanti, kiṃ kammam akāsi pubbe. || ||
pv35:2.1: Tato satthaṃ gahetvāna okkantanti punappunaṃ khārena paripphositvā okkantanti punappunaṃ. || ||
pv35:3.1: Kin nu kāyena vācāya manasā dukkaṭaṃ kataṃ kissa kammavipākena idaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchasi. || ||
pv35:4.1: Ahaṃ Rājagahe ramme ramaṇīye Giribbaje issaro dhanadhaññassa supahūtassa mārisa. || ||
pv35:5.1: Tassāyaṃ me bhariyā ca dhītā ca suṇisā ca me tā mālam uppalañ cāpi paccagghañ ca vilepanaṃ thūpaṃ harantiyo vāresiṃ taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā. || ||
pv35:6.1: Chaḷāsītisahassāni mayaṃ paccattavedanā thūpapūjaṃ vivaṇṇetvā paccāma niraye bhusaṃ. || ||
pv35:7.1: Ye ca kho thūpapūjāya vattante arahato mahe ādīnavaṃ pakāsenti, vivecayetha ne tato. || ||
pv35:8.1: Imā ca passa āyantiyo māladhārī alaṅkatā mālāvipākaṃ anubhontiyo samiddhā tā yasassiniyo. || ||
pv35:9.1: Tañ ca disvāna accheraṃ abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ namo karonti sappañña vandanti taṃ mahāmuniṃ. || ||
pv35:10.1: So hi nūna ito gantvā yoniṃ laddhāna mānusiṃ thūpapūjaṃ karissāmi appamatto punappunan ti. || ||
pv35:14.1: Abhijjamāno Kuṇḍiyo rathakārī bhusena ca kumāro gaṇikā c' eva dve luddā piṭṭh' apūjayo; vaggo tena pavaccatī ti.
